# include/memory Documentation

*This file is automatically generated by merging README files from multiple branches.*

## From branch: codex/add-readme-for-memory-components-2025-06-22


This directory exposes the public API for the engine's tiered memory system. The
matching source files live under `src/memory`.

- **`memory_tier.h` / `memory_tier.hpp`**
  - Declare the `MemoryTier` class and helper structures.
  - `src/memory/memory_tier.cpp` contains the full implementation including pool
    allocation, defragmentation and pattern storage logic.

- **`memory_tier_manager.hpp`**
  - Declares the `MemoryTierManager` singleton used to orchestrate the STM, MTM
    and LTM tiers.
  - Implemented in `src/memory/memory_tier_manager.cpp` where promotion,
    demotion and pattern relationship helpers reside.

- **`unified_memory.h`**
  - Header-only utility wrapping CUDA unified memory. Allocation requests are
    forwarded to `MemoryTierManager` so blocks are tracked alongside normal tier
    allocations.
  - `src/memory/memory.cu` instantiates this template for common primitive types.

Together these headers provide the interface to a three-tier memory hierarchy
while `src/memory` houses the underlying algorithms and CUDA specializations.

## From branch: codex/write-memory-readme-files-and-summarize-tier-management-2025-06-22


Public headers for the memory subsystem live here. They expose the tier manager,
allocation primitives and persistence helpers.

- **`memory_tier_manager.hpp`** – singleton controlling STM, MTM and LTM tiers.
- **`memory_tier.hpp`** and **`memory_tier.h`** – structures and inline methods for
  memory blocks and tier pools.
- **`unified_memory.h`** – lightweight RAII wrapper around CUDA's unified memory.
- **`types.h`** – shared enums plus the `RedisManager` API.

These headers are widely included so they remain worth keeping. Collapsing
`memory_tier.h` with `memory_tier.hpp` would reduce duplication. Minor logging
helpers in `manager.h` could merge with the source implementation.

## From branch: codex/write-memory-tier-and-redis-manager-documentation-2025-06-22


Public headers in this directory expose the tiered memory interface used throughout the engine.

- `memory_tier.hpp` implements a single tier allocator.
- `memory_tier_manager.hpp` coordinates STM, MTM and LTM promotion rules.
- `types.h` defines shared structures, including the optional `sep::persistence::RedisManager` when `hiredis` is available.

See `src/memory/README.md` for an overview of the tier design and persistence options.
